Har hafte 30 ghante FREE GPU 🤯 (Part 1/4)

₹0 GPU Club, Part 1: asli GPUs jo har hafte / har mahine refill hote hain 👇 🟦 Kaggle: 30 ghante GPU + 20 ghante TPU, har hafte (phone verify karna padta hai) 🟧 Google Colab: free T4 GPU, bas limit fixed nahi 🟩 Modal: har mahine $30 free credits ≈ 7.5 ghante H100 (coders ke liye)

One-time trial nahi, yeh refill hote hain. (Limits Oct 2026 ke hain, badal sakte hain.)

Part 2 kal: bina code ke free GPU. Aur Part 4 mein GIVEAWAY hai 🎁 charo part dekho. Follow karo @ai.mohit01 taaki miss na ho.
